recommendation: Treat enzyme constraints as guidance; add broader absolute proteomics and curated kcat values before building a production ecGEM.
Few kcat priors have matching measured proteins through GPRs, so many reactions cannot receive direct enzyme bounds.
Mean kcat confidence is modest; keep source tiers and confidence scores visible in downstream GECKO/sMOMENT runs.
